observations: Seven three-way junctions that are not T's keep a bare 90-degree wedge between two branches (the third branch is diagonal): 3V3A B(16.5,48.31) [0,90,225]; IMU_CS B(14.2,44.7) [0,135,270]; RAW_PROTECTED B(18.75,79.8) [90,225,315]; USB_LIMITED B(15.55,28.0) [0,135,270]; VBUS B(9.3,26.55) [0,135,270]; VLOGIC B(29.8,81.75) [0,135,270]; VLOGIC F(29.2,81.75) [45,180,315]. All were on 5516eeec. Each branch meets another at 135 degrees, so the 90-degree pair is a branch pair, as at a T. AGENTS section 3 / M2 define right_angle as two ends with nothing else there (a T or three or more ends is not a bend), so these are outside the rule.
